content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I want to find out if it's possible to connect [product_name] PLC with [product_name] drives.

[product_name] mainly supports Ethernet TCP/IP and MODBUS TCP/IP. It does not support Profibus or similar protocols. What kind of data do you want to exchange between [product_name] and [product_name] drives?

You can use the digital outputs from [product_name] to control the V20 drive’s digital inputs for functions like opening/closing or fixed speed operation. Analog outputs from [product_name] can be used for variable speed control of the drive.

analysis.insight_summary: The discussion centers around connecting [product_name] PLCs with [product_name] drives, emphasizing supported communication protocols and limitations. Users note that direct fieldbus communication, like Profibus, isn’t supported; instead, basic control can be done via digital and analog signals.
analysis.user_expectations: Users wish to directly connect and exchange data between [product_name] PLC and [product_name] drives, preferably using a digital communication protocol.
